answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before joining a task thread, so a Sybil operator must fund each fake identity. Any honest participant can challenge a suspicious agent by posting a small bond; if the challenged agent fails a liveness check, its stake is slashed and split between the challenger and the honest pool. This turns flooding the ocean of identities from cheap spam into an expensive gamble: every marble of fake reputation costs real capital, and the more identities an attacker spawns, the more collateral they risk losing to honest challengers.
